identity.title: Stabilize stale Native Tool focused WPF smoke assertions

origin.summary: The 2026-08-23 direct UI SDK Tool lifetime verification reproduced three focused-smoke assertion failures after the underlying Preview and Auto MPoint actions had completed.

state.current_summary: Resolved: the focused Native Tool smoke failures were stale test contracts. Range now checks the localized signal-inspector view while retaining marker/value/Preview assertions; EdgeBasedMatching restores the advanced PropertyGrid rows and checks the current Korean generated labels without Preview; Basic no longer requires a transient cue lifetime. Current-build isolated and combined runs pass.

claims.text: wpf_shell_host_threshold_tool expects English Lower/Upper overlay text while the current Korean Tool state does not expose those tokens through the asserted visual root.

wpf_shell_host_edge_based_matching_auto_mpoint completes candidate analysis/application but then searches for Korean unique-match PropertyGrid labels while the current generated rows use English display names.
wpf_shell_host_threshold_basic_tool can pass in a combined process and fail in an isolated process because it asserts visibility of a transient signal-evidence cue.

problem.impact: These assertion mismatches can block or confuse otherwise valid current-source UI verification and make the result depend on language, process order, or transient timing.

criteria.text: wpf_shell_host_threshold_tool verifies current localized signal-inspector evidence and passes without weakening marker/value/Preview assertions.
wpf_shell_host_edge_based_matching_auto_mpoint verifies the current generated PropertyGrid labels and still proves analysis/application caused no Preview, layer, active-layer, or routing side effect.
wpf_shell_host_threshold_basic_tool passes repeatably in both isolated and combined execution without relying on a transient cue lifetime.

context.location: Test maintenance only; the SDK Tool lifetime task did not admit a product UI behavior change.

evidence.observation: wpf_shell_host_threshold_tool failed only at the expected Lower text assertion after reporting Preview OK and Threshold_Preview 512x384.
wpf_shell_host_edge_based_matching_auto_mpoint reached a selected BEST candidate, exported its report, and created the Pipeline step before failing on expected Korean unique-match row text.
The isolated target failed at transient signal-cue visibility after the same target had passed in the six-target after run; wpf_direct_multi_tool_inspection then passed the Threshold Preview path.
The current-build combined run reported Status=OK with OK=3, WARN=0, NG=0 for wpf_shell_host_threshold_basic_tool, wpf_shell_host_threshold_tool, and wpf_shell_host_edge_based_matching_auto_mpoint.
The current-build isolated wpf_shell_host_threshold_tool run passed twice with Status=OK, preserving the localized signal-inspector evidence check and its marker/value/Preview assertions.
The current-build isolated wpf_shell_host_threshold_basic_tool run passed twice with Status=OK after the assertion stopped depending on transient signal-evidence cue visibility.

The current-build isolated EdgeBasedMatching Auto MPoint target passed with Status=OK after restoring advanced PropertyGrid visibility, checking the current Korean generated labels, and confirming the label inspection caused no Preview.

events.summary: PL-0003 resolved: all three stale focused-smoke contracts were corrected and current-build isolated/combined evidence passed C1-C3.
